ECO GOODIES BAG – A Eco-Friendly Gift Set | J480

The ECO GOODIES BAG – A Eco-Friendly Gift Set | J480 is a premium sustainable gifting option designed for brands, corporates, and eco-conscious individuals looking to make a responsible choice. This thoughtfully curated eco-friendly gift set features plantable seed pencils, plantable paper pens, a coco pot with coco peat, a reusable bamboo bottle (450ml), and a stylish forest wall stand with bamboo pen, all elegantly packed in an attractive jute mesh pouch with cotton net and zip (10″x10″x2″).

This eco gift set is ideal for corporate gifting, employee welcome kits, event giveaways, CSR activities, eco-friendly branding initiatives, and festival gifting. Each item inside the ECO GOODIES BAG | J480 promotes sustainability, biodegradability, and reusability—aligning with today’s growing environmental awareness.

Why Choose ECO GOODIES BAG – A Eco-Friendly Gift Set?

This eco-friendly goodies kit has been designed to inspire conscious living. From plantable stationery that grows into herbs or flowers, to a durable bamboo bottle and a rustic forest wall stand, every element contributes to reducing plastic usage and encouraging green habits. The ECO GOODIES BAG makes a memorable and impactful gift while promoting a brand’s commitment towards sustainability and environmental responsibility.

Key Features of ECO GOODIES BAG | J480

  • 3 Plantable Seed Pencils – Made from recycled materials and embedded with seeds. Once used, they can be planted to grow herbs or flowering plants.
  • 3 Plantable Paper Pens – Eco-friendly pens crafted using plantable seed paper. A perfect alternative to plastic pens.
  • 1 Coco Pot + Coco Peat – A biodegradable planting pot made from coconut husk with nutrient-rich coco peat for easy seed germination.
  • Packed in Paper Tube (75mm x 7″) – A sustainable paper-based tube that protects the plantable stationery while adding to the premium look.
  • Bamboo Bottle – 450ml – A stylish, natural, reusable bamboo water bottle designed to minimize plastic waste.
  • Forest Wall Stand + Bamboo Pen – A rustic wooden wall stand paired with an eco-friendly bamboo pen for practical everyday use.
  • Packed in Jute Mesh Pouch (10″x10″x2″) – Breathable jute pouch with cotton net and zip, recyclable and elegant for gifting.

Perfect for Sustainable & Corporate Gifting

The ECO GOODIES BAG – A Eco-Friendly Gift Set | J480 stands out as one of the most versatile eco gifts for organizations looking to promote sustainable values. Companies can use it for employee onboarding kits, eco-friendly event hampers, trade show giveaways, client gifting, and festival gift hampers. Its combination of plantable stationery and reusable bamboo essentials makes it highly functional and environmentally impactful.

Benefits of Choosing an Eco-Friendly Gift Set

  • Helps reduce single-use plastic consumption
  • Promotes sustainable lifestyle choices
  • Great for CSR and green-branding initiatives
  • Highly practical, attractive, and memorable gift
  • Supports environmental conservation efforts

Eco-Friendly Gift Set for Teams, Clients & Events

With high-quality materials, natural textures, and responsibly crafted products, this eco gift set appeals to professionals, eco-enthusiasts, and gifting planners looking for unique sustainable gift ideas. The plantable stationery helps recipients engage in a green activity, while the bamboo bottle and accessories offer long-term usability.

Conclusion

If you are looking for a meaningful, stylish, and sustainable gifting solution, the ECO GOODIES BAG – A Eco-Friendly Gift Set | J480 is the perfect choice. Designed with purpose and packed beautifully, it delivers both value and environmental responsibility. Ideal for branding, promotions, and thoughtful gifting, this eco goodies bag sets a new standard for eco-conscious corporate gifts.
